author: CNN
description:
President Donald Trump issued a remarkable, profanity-laced warning to Iran, warning of severe military action should Tehran fail to make a deal or reopen the Strait of Hormuz, a critical oil thoroughfare. 

He said in a post to social media that Tuesday, “will be Power Plant Day, and Bridge Day, all wrapped up in one, in Iran. There will be nothing like it!!! Open the F**kin’ Strait, you crazy bastards, or you’ll be living in Hell - JUST WATCH!”. 

0:00 Jake Tapper reads Trump’s profane threat to Iran 
0:44 Inside Politics panel gives initial reaction to Trump’s ‘over the top’ language in social media post 
4:31 CNN global affairs analyst reacts to Trump’s post referencing Allah 
6:46 Former Democratic rep. thinks Trump’s post shows the war is moving in the wrong direction
10:04 GOP strategist weighs in on escalating language being used by both sides of the Iran war

Watch more CNN here: https://cnn.it/4kh5RPe

#Iran #Trump #News
title: ‘Ok, wow!’: Trump’s profane Iran threat stuns CNN panel

author: CNN
description:
A missing US service member whose F-15 jet was shot down over Iran has been rescued by US forces in an operation that involved “dozens of aircraft,” President Donald Trump said. He added that the service member “sustained injuries, but he will be just fine.”

The high-stakes search began Friday after an F-15E Strike Eagle fighter jet was shot down in the region. Another crew member was rescued shortly after the crash and is receiving medical attention, CNN previously reported.

description: World no. 27 Ukrainian tennis player Marta Kostyuk returned home to Kyiv, Ukraine to train for the clay season.
